# EU5 1.4.9 cabinet_actions: bare country scope in potential/allow; AI scoring uses ai_will_do.
oe_amr_cab_mesoamerican_reformation = {
	ability = adm
	icon = pop_promote_action
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			oe_amr_is_mesoamerica_axis = yes
			AND = {
				exists = religion
				religion = religion:nahuatl
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations > 0
	}

	country_modifier = {
		monthly_nahualt_reform_progress = 0.12
		global_monthly_literacy = 0.02
		global_disease_resistance = 0.08
		clergy_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.04
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 12 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_has_disease = disease:great_pestilence }
				add = { value = 20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = religion
					religion = religion:nahuatl
					NOT = { has_completed_religious_focus = oe_amr_rf_anti_pestilence_herbalism }
				}
				add = { value = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes }
				subtract = { value = 8 }
			}
		}
	}
}
